changelog: Dynamic FTP Server Manager & 100% Automatic Discovery: paste any FTP URL playable on your Wi-Fi (h5ai, Apache, Nginx, Caddy, IIS, or BDIX portal) with zero manual protocol selection — CineVault automatically detects the server, recursively discovers all compatible movie & series folders, and merges titles cleanly across all servers.

Instant Disabled-Server Visibility Control: disabling any server immediately hides all of its files across Home, Browse, Search, Filters, Watchlist, Continue Watching, and Detail mirrors (promoting surviving mirrors on active servers) — and re-enabling restores them instantly without re-syncing.

YouTube Premium-Style Background Play, PiP & Mini-Player Drawer: continuous screen-off background audio via foreground MediaPlaybackService with lock-screen & notification controls (-10s, Play/Pause, +10s, Stop), minimizable live Mini-Player Drawer Bar with zero re-buffering, native Picture-in-Picture (PiP), and background in-app downloads.
